<?php
require_once 'wordpress/wp-load.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/image.php';

foreach ( array( 'lite-site', 'no-lite-site' ) as $slug ) {
	if ( ! get_term_by( 'slug', $slug, 'category' ) ) {
		wp_insert_term( $slug, 'category', array( 'slug' => $slug ) );
	}
}

/*
 * Sample media is drawn locally with GD rather than sideloaded. Playground has
 * no working DNS (gethostbyname returns a random local IP), so download_url()
 * and media_sideload_image() fail there for the same reason the RSS import does.
 */
if ( ! function_exists( 'imagecreatetruecolor' ) ) {
	return;
}

$specs = array(
	array( 'Harbour wall at first light', array( 38, 70, 83 ) ),
	array( 'Newsroom, second floor', array( 42, 157, 143 ) ),
	array( 'Transit hub on a midweek morning', array( 233, 196, 106 ) ),
	array( 'Flood barrier on the east bank', array( 244, 162, 97 ) ),
	array( 'Council chamber, before the vote', array( 231, 111, 81 ) ),
	array( 'Relay tower above the ridge road', array( 105, 109, 125 ) ),
);

$use_jpeg = function_exists( 'imagejpeg' );
$ext      = $use_jpeg ? 'jpg' : 'png';
$mime     = $use_jpeg ? 'image/jpeg' : 'image/png';
$uploads  = wp_upload_dir();
$width    = 1200;
$height   = 675;

foreach ( $specs as $index => $spec ) {
	list( $caption, $rgb ) = $spec;

	$image = imagecreatetruecolor( $width, $height );
	imagefilledrectangle( $image, 0, 0, $width, $height, imagecolorallocate( $image, $rgb[0], $rgb[1], $rgb[2] ) );

	// Horizontal banding, so each placeholder is visually distinct at a glance.
	for ( $band = 0; $band < 6; $band++ ) {
		$shade = imagecolorallocate(
			$image,
			min( 255, $rgb[0] + ( $band * 16 ) ),
			min( 255, $rgb[1] + ( $band * 16 ) ),
			min( 255, $rgb[2] + ( $band * 16 ) )
		);
		imagefilledrectangle( $image, 0, (int) ( $height / 6 * $band ), $width, (int) ( $height / 6 * ( $band + 1 ) ), $shade );
	}

	$white = imagecolorallocate( $image, 255, 255, 255 );
	imagestring( $image, 5, 40, $height - 70, 'SAMPLE IMAGE ' . ( $index + 1 ), $white );
	imagestring( $image, 3, 40, $height - 46, strtoupper( $caption ), $white );

	$filename = sprintf( 'lite-site-sample-%02d.%s', $index + 1, $ext );
	$path     = trailingslashit( $uploads['path'] ) . $filename;

	if ( $use_jpeg ) {
		imagejpeg( $image, $path, 82 );
	} else {
		imagepng( $image, $path );
	}
	imagedestroy( $image );

	$attachment_id = wp_insert_attachment(
		array(
			'post_mime_type' => $mime,
			'post_title'     => $caption,
			'post_excerpt'   => $caption,
			'post_content'   => '',
			'post_status'    => 'inherit',
		),
		$path
	);

	if ( $attachment_id && ! is_wp_error( $attachment_id ) ) {
		wp_update_attachment_metadata( $attachment_id, wp_generate_attachment_metadata( $attachment_id, $path ) );
		update_post_meta( $attachment_id, '_wp_attachment_image_alt', $caption );
	}
}
